props.name: children
props.type: number | boolean | Node | JSX.ArrayElement | (string & {}) | ((renderProps: CardRenderProps) => JSX.Element)
props.description: The children of the Card.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the Card.

props.name: density
props.description: The amount of internal padding within the Card.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual style of the Card.

props.name: mesh
props.description: The register's woven hex-mesh weave, painted behind the glass fill — `ambient` is the quiet mixed gray/blue/orange weave, `signal` the warm single-hue amber one. Only the filled variants take it; `tertiary` and `quiet` have no fill for a weave to sit under.

props.name: meshSeed
props.description: Seed for the mesh weave, so neighboring cards don't repeat the same pattern.

props.name: href
props.description: Link target for standalone navigable cards.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: slot
props.description: Slot name when used in a Spectrum context.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLElement | ((el: HTMLElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the rendered card element.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique key for the item.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Handler called when the item is activated.

props.name: item
props.description: The item value.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The text value of the item (for accessibility).

props.name: background
props.description: Recessed fill behind the preview. `inset` sits the region on `--surface-inset` — the register's console-strip treatment, where the full-bleed header bar reads sunk into the card rather than flush with it.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.
